description: Installation of 1No. BT Street Hub Unit and associated advertisement panels on either side of the unit
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">The minimum display time for each advertisement shall be 10 seconds, the use of message sequencing for the same product is prohibited and the advertisements shall not include features/equipment which would allow interactive messages/advertisements to be displayed.&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Reason: to ensure the safety of road users</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">There shall be no special effects (including noise, smell, smoke, animation, exposed cold cathode tubing, flashing, scrolling, three dimensional, intermittent or video elements) of any kind during the time that any message is displayed.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Reason: in the interest of protecting the safety of road users</span></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">The footway along Amhurst Park should not be blocked during the installation of the proposed communication kiosk. Temporary obstructions during the replacement and installation should be kept to a minimum.</span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"><br></span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Reason: to provide safe passage for pedestrians on Amhurst Park.</span></p>
The existing kiosks must be removed ahead of the implementation of the new kiosk.&nbsp;

<p>The applicant should consider the minimum acceptable footway zones and should refer to the guidance found in Chapter 11 of https://content.tfl.gov.uk/streetscape-guidance-2022-revision-2.pdf. Footway zones should be agreed with TfL prior to installation of the proposed communication kiosk, to ensure that the proposal does not encroach on the clear space required for pedestrian passage and does not cause congestion on Amhurst Park during peak pedestrian demand.&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p>For lighting during the day, either no lighting, or maximum lighting levels (such as for digital displays) are set in accord with nighttime maximums or controlled, so they comply with the guidance approach to ambient lighting. If not proposed in the application, this should be secured by condition.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p>Illumination for the proposed sign must remain below the limit set out in the Institute of Lighting Professionals (ILP) publication: “The Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements including digital displays” (PLG05/23, 2023).&nbsp;</p>

<p>All vehicles associated with the installation of the communication kiosk and associated advert must only park/stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions</p>
